decision.observation: 2 mph, gear 1, timer 46:50.667 - a clean overhead view with the car centred on the gravel. Road runs up-frame, bending left past a white two-storey house with pines, then right toward the big red barn with cows and white paddock fence on the right.
decision.hypothesis: Centred and aligned at 2 mph, a plain-W build should be safe for the near straight before the left bend, without the drift that appears when steering is mixed in early.
decision.memory: The black frame lasted only a few seconds and resolved into normal gameplay at the same location - so black frames are fades/loads, not results. Confirmed: big red barn + white paddock fence + cows cluster is the same landmark set seen multiple times from both directions, strengthening (still not proving) a loop.
